reason: PURE. First thing I noticed was the 200 mg elemental and 'no oxide' on the front, then the sachets that fit in my tote next to the charger. I would try one box, but only after I open the QR and see a real batch report from the named lab.
objection: A QR and 'lab-tested' is what every brand says. I only believe it if the report is a real page for my batch with actual magnesium and heavy metal numbers, not a generic PDF.
would_change_my_mind: Opening the QR and finding a batch-specific report with numbers from the named ISO 17025 lab that matches the label.
